item.title: #9 Tigers focused for 2026 with “unfinished business” on their minds
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. — Following a historic 2025 campaign that saw the Tigers ranked as high as 13th in the postseason polls, the Campbellsville University men's volleyball team enters 2026 with a No. 9 national ranking and a singular focus: finishing the job.

item.title: Johnson’s 16 points, stifling defense lead Lady Tigers past Cumberland, 67-55
item.description: LEBANON, Tenn. – The #3 Campbellsville University Lady Tigers took to the road on Thursday night and used efficient shooting and a dominant interior defense to secure a 67-55 Mid-South Conference victory over the Cumberland University Phoenix.

item.title: 8 Tiger blocks quench Phoenix, 72-56
item.description: LEBANON, Tenn. – The Campbellsville University men's basketball team secured its first Mid-South Conference victory of the season on Thursday night, utilizing a stifling defensive effort, highlighted by eight blocked shots, to defeat Cumberland University, 72-56, at the Dallas Floyd Arena.

item.title: #9 Tigers upset #3 St. Thomas in 5-set thriller to sweep home opener
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. — The #9 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team electrified Gosser Gymnasium on Saturday, opening the 2026 campaign with two victories, including a dramatic, reverse-sweep upset over #3 St. Thomas University.

item.title: Tigers touch wall on regular season; eyes turn to MSC Championships
item.description: COLUMBIA, Ky. – The Campbellsville University swim teams concluded their 2025-26 regular season campaign Saturday at the Highway 55 Last Chance Invitational, facing off against host Lindsey Wilson University.

item.title: Bell topples school record as Tigers earn podium finishes at split weekend
item.description: DANVILLE, Ky. / LOUISVILLE, Ky. — The Campbellsville University Track & Field teams rewrote the record books this weekend, with Marcus Bell setting a new indoor school record to highlight a successful outing at the Centre Indoor Showcase. While a contingent of sprinters faced Division I competition at the PNC Bank Bellarmine Classic in Louisville, the bulk of the squad competed in Danville, where the men claimed second place overall and the women secured third.

item.title: Tigers battle at Missouri Valley Invite; Hinton and Schlosser highlight weekend
item.description: MARSHALL, Mo. – The #7 Campbellsville University men's wrestling team faced a demanding field this weekend at the Missouri Valley Invite. While the Tigers struggled to advance deep into the championship brackets, several individuals secured key victories, highlighted by a quarterfinal run from Wyatt Hinton and a ranked win for Luke Schlosser.

item.title: Lady Tigers land at #4 in NAIA Poll; MSC dominates top five
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – The Campbellsville University women's basketball team appears in the top five for the fifth consecutive rating period, checking in at #4 in the latest NAIA Women's Basketball Coaches' Top 25 Poll released Wednesday morning.
